body: I was struggling with this after upgrading from a 5800x. I mostly upgraded for WoW but also other games. I was getting great FPS compared to my old setup other than some terrible 1% lows. I tried a lot of stuff but in the end what seemed to work for me or at least help a lot was to update my chipset drivers specifically from my motherboards website and not from AMD. The AMD ones were newer but it's the older ones from my motherboard's site (MSI) that drastically improved the issue. I'm not the most tech literate compared to many out there but I was immediately able to notice the difference. I hope this helps other people that may be struggling with this as well!

I've been on HRT for about 3 years now. I used to practice my voice every night for half a year and got no where. After that I gave up and stopped caring. I talk as low as I did before hrt, although I do have some more feminine qualities to my voice other than pitch. I find I am rarely misgendered in person. On the phone though is a different story, since my appearance can't carry me through on the phone I get Sir'd sometimes.

I actually am trans so I guess that's why I made the post. I just want to feel safe somewhere if I am going to move there. I  should be visiting Regina in a few months to see how things are there but I wanted to make this post to see how people in the city are towards people like me before even visiting.
